emails.subject: Re: claim NF-2026-0331-AC — repair estimate you asked for
emails.body:
Hi Renata —

Finally got the body shop to send through the estimate you'd asked for last week on my Subaru — attached is the PDF from Northbay Collision, $3,612 for the rear bumper and tailgate. Sorry it took a few days; their estimator was out.

Let me know if you need anything else from my side, otherwise I'll wait to hear from you on next steps.

Thanks,
Andrea Choi

emails.subject: Trying to schedule the recorded statement around my attorney's travel — which afternoons are open?
emails.body:
Hi Renata —

Quick logistics question, no urgency on the claim itself.

Following up on NF-2026-0322-AC (the hail-damage claim on the Civic). I know the next step on your end is the recorded statement — my attorney (Bridget Cho at Cho & Halverson) wants to be on the call with me, and she'll be travelling out of state from late next week through the following Tuesday for a hearing she has in Phoenix, so we'd really like to lock the call in before she leaves.

Could you let me know which afternoons you have open over the next two weeks — ideally something earlier in that window, before Bridget leaves? Recorded statements run about an hour I think? I just need to know your availability windows so I can pick one that works for both of us. I'm not asking you to put it on your calendar — I'm happy to call the front desk on Monday once Bridget and I have agreed on a window from your options, I just need to coordinate with her first.

If afternoons don't work, mornings are okay too — afternoons are just easier for Bridget. I'd really appreciate hearing back by tomorrow if you can swing it; if not no worries, I can move things around on my end.

Thanks so much,
Ramona Estévez
